title: mcpx: procStat in internal/mcpclient/handoff.go is Linux-only (/proc/<pid>/stat) — breaks handoff identity on darwin

labels.name: kind/bug
labels.description: Something isn't working (prefixed form of the classic bug label)

labels.name: task/small-fix
labels.description: Queue packet kind: bounded fix with reproduction and targeted tests

labels.name: app/mcpx

body:
Split from #237 (triage task 11867, 2026-11-08) — the remaining concrete defect from that issue, scoped on its own so it can be fixed and verified independently of the darwin takeover support-or-refuse decision that stays on #237.

## Defect

`pkgs/mcpx/internal/mcpclient/handoff.go:180` — `procStat(pid)` reads `/proc/<pid>/stat` unconditionally (verified at `origin/main` 801ceb9cb16668041e85b4451443ac7d91647ffe). The file has no build constraints and there is no darwin alternative, so the process start-time / identity checks used during handoff detach (`ProcessStartTime`, and the pid-identity check at handoff.go:166-175) fail on any platform without `/proc` — including aarch64-darwin, where mcpx is deployed via dezren39/nix.

## Evidence

- dezren39/nix#471 (queue task 8082), aarch64-darwin verification run: `TestHandoffCarriesExecIdentityForRelativeCommand` fails at `handoff_exec_test.go:39` with `detach: server "fake": child 11053: open /proc/11053/stat: no such file or directory`. It is the only failing package (`internal/pool`, via this path) and it gates the nix mcpx package checkPhase.
- Same family as #237 item 3 (`/proc/<pid>/exe`), which PR #3288 already fixed for the daemon test package; this one is in production (non-test) code.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Process start-time/identity for handoff works on aarch64-darwin via a portable source (e.g. sysctl `kern.proc` KP_EPROC / `proc_pidpath`-family equivalent), **or** returns an explicit unsupported-platform error and the affected handoff tests skip on darwin with a stated reason — no bare `/proc/...stat: no such file or directory` failures
- [ ] `internal/mcpclient` and `internal/pool` suites still pass on Linux with no regressions; `pkgs/mcpx/scripts/darwin-compile-check.sh` still passes
- [ ] After the fix lands, the result names the cross-repo remainder: advance the mcpx pin in dezren39/nix so dezren39/nix#471's parked aarch64-darwin verification can resume (cross-repo set rule — tracked from #237, no duplicate filing)

## Out of scope

- The darwin takeover/upgrade support-or-refuse decision (stays on #237)
- Any other `/proc` uses in test helpers already covered by PR #3288
